headline: CenterPoint Energy (CNP) Gets A Zacks Upgrade And Dividend Lift, Is It Fully Priced?
summary: CenterPoint Energy (CNP) has drawn fresh attention after a Zacks Rank upgrade to #2 and a Board decision to lift its regular quarterly cash dividend to US$0.2400 per share, effective September 2026. headline: CenterPoint Energy (CNP) Stock Looks Above Fair Value With Strong 5 Year Returns
summary: CenterPoint Energy stock has almost doubled investors' money over the past five years, yet its valuation checks currently lean toward the shares being on the expensive side rather than a clear bargain. CenterPoint Energy has delivered a 98.6% total return over five years, which puts extra focus on whether the current price already reflects much of its long term potential.
